style.comment: 字体、字号、行距、段距。换模板时补一条新属性是正常演进，不是失败。 / Fonts, sizes, line and paragraph spacing. Adding a property for a new template is normal evolution, not a failure.

outline.comment: 章节顺序与每章必须回答的问题。 / Section order and the question each section must answer.

format.comment: 单位、量级、小数位。这一份最容易被忽略，也最容易错了不响。 / Units, magnitudes and decimals. This block is the easiest to overlook, and a mistake here is silent.

rules.source: 模板默认：一级标题比正文醒目，且与上一节留出间隔 / template default: a level-1 heading is more prominent than body text and separated from the previous section
模板默认：正文的通用版式 / template default: the general body layout
模板默认：体积按 10⁶ m³ 两位小数；result.json 仍存原始 m³ / template default: volume as 10⁶ m³ with two decimals; result.json still stores raw m³
模板默认：先给结论，再给过程 / template default: give the conclusion first, then the process
